messages:
Eric (CEO): Thanks for joining the all-hands — quick follow-up thread for infra/capacity questions. We'll post the short ramp schedule and follow-ups here. Lee & Priya, feel free to drop updates.

Lee (Infra): Slide deck here: https://redwood.internal/slides/infra-capacity Mar 2026 section. TL;DR: A100 shipments delayed ~2 weeks vs timeline we showed; we have a partial slot fill plan with T4s and burst buckets.

Mike (Ops): Is the autoscaler going to pre-warm T4s automatically to cover the gap or will we rely on on-demand? Concern: some latency-sensitive routes can't tolerate the cold start.

Lee (Infra): Autoscaler policy change: new 'burst_bucket' allows short-term capacity beyond reserved pools. Prewarm policy: tiered prewarm for latency-SLO routes (config: `prewarmPolicy: {minReady: 2, ttl: 600}`). Non-SLO routes will use on-demand.

Anna (Product): How will this affect Dedicated customers? Any changes to committed capacity? We need to communicate billing/overage behavior.

Priya (Eng): Dedicated stays unchanged — customers with reserved pools keep their capacity. Burst_bucket applied after reserved capacity; overage billing only if burst exceeds contracted burst_limit. We will email affected customers with exact thresholds.

Jordan (Eng): For APAC customers: can we get a concrete date for APAC region availability? Last slide was vague.

Lee (Infra): APAC soft-open targets shifted: internal canaries by 2026-04-12, public beta 2026-04-26, GA 2026-05-10 (if hardware arrival steady). We'll update the public tracker.

Sara (SRE): What's the canary rollback plan if the new prewarm/autoscaler causes instability? Any circuit-breakers?

Priya (Eng): Circuit-breakers: automatic fallback to lower-memory model variants + region fallthrough. Canary monitors: latency p95, error-rate; automatic rollback threshold = +20% p95 or >1% error spikes over 5m.

Mike (Ops): Does fallback include routing to CPU for low-priority jobs? We saw high queueing last week.

Lee (Infra): Yes for non-critical workloads. Routing policy: `fallback_policy: [reserved_pool, burst_bucket, cross-region, cpu_fallback]` — order is configurable per-tenant.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy `infra/autoscaler:v2.3.1` to dev-canary at 2026-04-08T18:00Z — watch `#eng-oncall`.

Eric (CEO): Thanks — plan to hold a 30-min office hours tomorrow (2026-04-09 16:00 PT) specifically on capacity & dedicated questions. Drop any items here and we'll prep answers. :thumbsup:

Anna (Product): Adding: need a one-pager for account execs summarizing impacts and messaging.

Lee (Infra): I'll post the one-pager in #eng-ops by EOD today.

Jordan (Eng): small ask — can we get a CLI snippet to query current burst usage per-customer? Would help SEs.

Priya (Eng): CLI coming. Example: `rwctl infra burst-usage --customer acme --window 1h` — will return usage and projected burn rate.

Sara (SRE): noted. I'll add runbook entries for the new fallback paths.
